name: dsh-link-panel
description: The panel item registry and the pane that shows it: items are data (id, kind, title, source, order) with a closed kind set, the projection is a pure function that returns the sorted visible items plus every refused item by name, one read-only GET route serves both readings, and the browser half draws them in a right-rail pane (kind pane) beside the note ledger, where one note at a time can be written through /api/dsh-link-notes/add. No persistence, no registry write surface.
